_comment: Synthetic QA portraits (segmind/SSD-1B, Apache-2.0, + sdxl-vae-fp16-fix; DPM++ 2M Karras 10 steps, 832x1024; adults, clothed; no real people). `labels` = targeted labels after SigLIP QC (null = not targeted or masked); `targeted` = before QC; `masked` = heads SigLIP disagreed with. `face` = YuNet 5-point landmarks in this JPEG's pixel coordinates (eyeL/mouthL = image-left). `crop` = the Python reference aligned crop (224 px) per taxonomy.json `crop`, for crop-parity tests.
